name: Oddish
flavour_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavour_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Bellossom
flavour_text: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Tangela
flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavour_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Yanma
flavour_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Roselia
flavour_text: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Roserade
flavour_text: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Turtwig
flavour_text: It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from hardened soil.

name: Grotle
flavour_text: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

name: Torterra
flavour_text: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground dwelt a gigantic Torterra.

name: Kricketot
flavour_text: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Kricketune
flavour_text: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

name: Burmy
flavour_text: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Wormadam
flavour_text: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

name: Combee
flavour_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Vespiquen
flavour_text: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Carnivine
flavour_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Leafeon
flavour_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Mow Rotom
flavour_text: The lawn mower is one of the household appliances that led to the development of the Rotom Dex.

name: Shaymin
flavour_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Magmar
flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Magmortar
flavour_text: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Slugma
flavour_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavour_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Chimchar
flavour_text: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

name: Monferno
flavour_text: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Heat Rotom
flavour_text: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

name: Swinub
flavour_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavour_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine
flavour_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Regice
flavour_text: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Prinplup
flavour_text: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

name: Empoleon
flavour_text: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

name: Buizel
flavour_text: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavour_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Shellos
flavour_text: It used to have a shell on its back long ago. This species is closely related to Pokémon like Shellder.

name: Gastrodon
flavour_text: They normally inhabit rocky seashores, but in times of continuous rain, they can sometimes be found in the mountains, far from the sea.

name: Finneon
flavour_text: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
flavour_text: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

name: Snover
flavour_text: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavour_text: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Glaceon
flavour_text: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Wash Rotom
flavour_text: This Rotom has entered a washing machine. It nods with satisfaction after it floods the surrounding area.

name: Frost Rotom
flavour_text: This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. It leaps around gleefully after it uses cold air to freeze the area around it.

name: Manaphy
flavour_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavour_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavour_text: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Electabuzz
flavour_text: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Electivire
flavour_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Shinx
flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavour_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Rotom
flavour_text: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Togepi
flavour_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavour_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavour_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Misdreavus
flavour_text: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Duskull
flavour_text: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.

name: Dusclops
flavour_text: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

name: Dusknoir
flavour_text: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Drifloon
flavour_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
flavour_text: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

name: Uxie
flavour_text: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Mesprit
flavour_text: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Azelf
flavour_text: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

name: Giratina
flavour_text: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

name: Cresselia
flavour_text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Rhyhorn
flavour_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavour_text: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Rhyperior
flavour_text: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

name: Gligar
flavour_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavour_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Hitmontop
flavour_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Nosepass
flavour_text: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it’s in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Regirock
flavour_text: Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.

name: Cranidos
flavour_text: A primeval Pokémon, it possesses a hard and sturdy skull, lacking any intelligence within.

name: Rampardos
flavour_text: In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder than steel, to make helmets.

name: Wormadam
flavour_text: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Lucario
flavour_text: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Hippopotas
flavour_text: It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.

name: Hippowdon
flavour_text: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

name: Murkrow
flavour_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavour_text: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sneasel
flavour_text: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Poochyena
flavour_text: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavour_text: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Stunky
flavour_text: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Skuntank
flavour_text: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

name: Spiritomb
flavour_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Skorupi
flavour_text: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

name: Drapion
flavour_text: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

name: Croagunk
flavour_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavour_text: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Darkrai
flavour_text: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Skarmory
flavour_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Registeel
flavour_text: Registeel’s body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

name: Shieldon
flavour_text: A mild-mannered, herbivorous Pokémon, it used its face to dig up tree roots to eat. The skin on its face was plenty tough.

name: Bastiodon
flavour_text: The bones of its face are huge and hard, so they were mistaken for its spine until after this Pokémon was successfully restored.

name: Wormadam
flavour_text: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

name: Bronzor
flavour_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavour_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Probopass
flavour_text: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don’t come back.

name: Heatran
flavour_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Gible
flavour_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavour_text: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Garchomp
flavour_text: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Lickitung
flavour_text: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavour_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavour_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

name: Starly
flavour_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavour_text: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
flavour_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Bidoof
flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bibarel
flavour_text: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavour_text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Glameow
flavour_text: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

name: Purugly
flavour_text: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

name: Chatot
flavour_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

name: Fan Rotom
flavour_text: This Rotom has entered an electric fan. It smirks with satisfaction over a prank well pulled after it blows away everything around it.

name: Regigigas
flavour_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Tangrowth
flavour_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

flavour_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.
